note: Do Re Mi Re Do, one note per beat, over a drone and the staff's metronome. The old tempo ladder (a Stage choice of 60, 76 and 92 bpm) is moves, kept to a beginner's 40 to 60 bpm, and the key is moves too; the lines about another tempo and key open with {{?bpm}} and {{?key}}.

exercise.title: Do Re Mi on the beat
exercise.why: A step up and back is the shape most tunes start with, and the metronome shows whether your voice gets to each note on time.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone, the metronome and the mic start together, at {{=bpm}}. Sing {{1}}, {{2}}, {{3}}, {{2}}, {{1}}, one note per beat. Sing it on the note names.
Practice until every note starts on the click, not after it.
{{?bpm}}At a faster tempo the notes come closer together, and each one still starts on the click.
{{?key}}In another key the drone moves, and the three notes are still one step apart.
